# ARCUS LLC

> AI governance and data protection for companies in the Gulf: which AI tools a company may use, what may go into them, and who is accountable. Registered in the Qatar Financial Centre.

ARCUS LLC is registered in the Qatar Financial Centre (QFC No. 04428), Doha, Qatar.
It covers Qatar, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman.
Its free questionnaire (about ten minutes) returns a written AI governance exposure report within 48 hours.
ARCUS LLC is not a law firm; every legal reference it publishes is traced to the issuing authority.

## Key pages
- [Website](https://arcus.consulting): services and the free questionnaire
- [ARCUS Insights](https://arcusgcc.github.io/): news on AI governance and data protection law in the GCC
- [About](https://arcusgcc.github.io/about.html)
